experience.title: Intern Full Stack Developer
highlights: Engineered and maintained production applications across mobile and responsive web using React Native, Node.js, MariaDB, and SQLite.
Built modular inventory management workflows, retail billing logic, and automated GST-compliant calculation engines.
Implemented local-first offline storage synchronization between SQLite and remote MariaDB instances, handling data consistency and reconciliation across unstable connections.
Configured push notifications and unified error telemetry to track operational exceptions and runtime app health.
Participated in build deployments, production triage, and resolution of urgent client incidents.
